_note: Working practices the copy may state only when ticked in the client's confirmed_practices (Client Values screen). 'detect' patterns are what the validator's PRACTICE check looks for in the copy; 'question' is the onboarding form question. Draft list, 14 Oct 2026: review before the onboarding form is updated.

practices.label: Quotes given in writing
practices.claim: quotes are given in writing
practices.question: Do you give every quote in writing?

practices.label: Itemised quotes
practices.claim: quotes are itemised
practices.question: Do your quotes list each item of work and its cost?

practices.label: Quote includes materials, labour and waste removal
practices.claim: the quote covers materials, labour and taking the waste away
practices.question: Does your quote include materials, labour and waste removal?

practices.label: Start date agreed when the quote is accepted
practices.claim: the start date is agreed when the quote is accepted
practices.question: Do you agree a start date at the point the quote is accepted?
detect: \bstart date\b[^.]{0,40}\b(quote|before we leave|on the day|at the visit)\b

practices.label: We visit before quoting
practices.claim: the business visits the site before giving a quote
practices.question: Do you visit the property before giving a quote?

practices.label: Bigger projects are booked further ahead
practices.claim: bigger projects are booked further ahead
practices.question: Are bigger projects booked further ahead than small jobs?

practices.label: Regular visits on an agreed schedule
practices.claim: regular visits run to an agreed schedule
practices.question: Do regular maintenance customers get an agreed visit schedule?

practices.label: No subcontractors: our own team does every job
practices.claim: the business's own team does every job, with no subcontractors
practices.question: Does your own team do every job, with no subcontractors?

practices.label: The owner works on or oversees every job
practices.claim: the owner works on or oversees every job
practices.question: Do you (the owner) work on or oversee every job yourself?

practices.label: The same team from start to finish
practices.claim: the same people work on the job from start to end
practices.question: Does the same team stay on a job from start to end?

practices.label: Work area left tidy at the end of each day
practices.claim: the work area is left tidy at the end of each day
practices.question: Do you leave the work area tidy at the end of each day?

practices.label: All waste taken away
practices.claim: all waste is taken away
practices.question: Do you take all the waste away at the end of the job?

practices.label: Updates at each stage of the job
practices.claim: customers get an update at each stage
practices.question: Do you update customers at each stage of the job?

practices.label: Aftercare advice at the end of the job
practices.claim: aftercare advice is given at the end of the job
practices.question: Do you give aftercare advice when a job is finished?

practices.label: We come back to put right anything that isn't right
practices.claim: the business comes back to put right anything that isn't right
practices.question: If something isn't right after a job, do you come back to put it right?

practices.label: Photos of every fault before we quote
practices.claim: customers are shown photos of every fault before the quote
practices.question: Do you photograph faults and show the customer before quoting?

practices.label: Roof left watertight every night
practices.claim: the roof is left watertight every night
practices.question: Do you leave the roof watertight at the end of every day?

practices.label: Scaffolding included in the quote
practices.claim: scaffolding is included in the quote
practices.question: Is scaffolding included in your quotes?

practices.label: Extra work is priced and agreed before it is done
practices.claim: any extra work found during the job is priced and agreed with the customer before it is done
practices.question: If you find extra work once the job has started, how do you price it, and do you agree it with the customer before you do it?

practices.label: Weather delays: the customer is told and the work is rebooked
practices.claim: if the weather stops the work, the customer is told and the work is rebooked
practices.question: If rain or wind stops the work, what do you do: do you tell the customer and rebook, and does it change the price?

practices.label: The house, drive and access are protected during the work
practices.claim: the house, drive and paths are protected and access is kept clear during the work
practices.question: How do you get materials and machinery to the job, and how do you protect the house, drive, paths and neighbours' access while you work?

practices.label: The price is agreed before any work starts
practices.claim: the price is agreed with the customer before any work starts
practices.question: Is the price always agreed with the customer before any work starts?

practices.label: Weeds are taken out by the root
practices.claim: weeds are lifted out whole, roots and all
practices.question: When you clear weeds, do you take the roots out rather than cut them at the surface?

practices.label: Bare soil is covered after a clearance
practices.claim: bare soil is covered (mulched) after a bed is cleared
practices.question: After you clear a bed, do you cover the bare soil with mulch or planting?

practices.label: Hedges are checked for nesting birds before cutting
practices.claim: hedges are checked for nesting birds before any cutting
practices.question: Do you check a hedge for nesting birds before you cut it?

practices.label: Leaves are cleared from lawns in autumn
practices.claim: fallen leaves are cleared from the lawn in autumn
practices.question: Do your autumn visits include clearing fallen leaves off the lawn?

practices.label: Green waste taken away, or left, as the customer chooses
practices.claim: green waste is taken away, or left for the customer, whichever they choose
practices.question: Do you take green waste away, leave it for the customer, or offer both?

practices.label: Winter debris cleared before the first cut of the year
practices.claim: the winter debris is cleared before the first cut of the year
practices.question: Before the first cut of the year, do you clear the winter debris off the lawn first?

practices.label: Edges and tight corners finished with a strimmer
practices.claim: the edges and tight corners are finished with a strimmer
practices.question: Do you finish the edges and the corners the mower cannot reach with a strimmer?

practices.label: Paths and hard surfaces swept after mowing
practices.claim: the paths and hard surfaces are swept after mowing
practices.question: Do you sweep the paths and hard surfaces clear of cuttings before you leave?

practices.label: The customer does not need to be home for a visit
practices.claim: the customer does not need to be home for a visit
practices.question: Can a visit go ahead when nobody is home, as long as the garden can be reached?
detect: \b(?:don't|do not|doesn't|does not|no) need (?:to be|to stay) (?:in|at home|home|there|around)\b
\bnobody (?:needs to be|has to be|need be) (?:in|at home|home|there)\b
